dialogues.speaker: Huixin
dialogues.text: You could say the Qixing are my bosses... Surely it doesn't count as workplace gossip if I'm just giving you their backstories? Haha...

dialogues.speaker: Huixin
dialogues.text: The Qixing — or "Seven Stars" — is a Liyue business committee. It is also used as a collective term for the seven business tycoons who sit on the committee and handle Liyue's government affairs.

dialogues.speaker: Huixin
dialogues.text: I trust you have heard of Ningguang, of the Jade Chamber? Like her, each Qixing is a major player in business circles whose every action has a profound influence.

dialogues.speaker: Huixin
dialogues.text: They are responsible for implementing the policy that comes down from Rex Lapis and making rulings on important matters. They are akin to the hands and feet of Rex Lapis.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Could you tell me a bit more about the Qixing?

dialogues.speaker: Huixin
dialogues.text: Hmm, the Qixing do in fact have a clear internal division of labor.

dialogues.speaker: Huixin
dialogues.text: Besides Lady Ningguang, with whom you are familiar, the Yuheng, Lady Keqing, is in charge of land, construction works and the like.

dialogues.speaker: Huixin
dialogues.text: Liyue is very vast, and requires strict regulation and eminent developmental direction...

dialogues.speaker: Huixin
dialogues.text: The other esteemed members of the Qixing are also highly accomplished in their own fields. They are the pillars of the prosperity that Liyue enjoys today.
